description: Canonical ACTIVE-egress allowlist consumed by scripts/scan-outbound-network.cjs (Phase 33.5-04). Each entry permits the matched file(s) to make outbound network calls / child-process spawns of gh|curl|wget. Any ACTIVE-egress site (require/import of node:http(s)|http(s)|ws|node-fetch|axios|undici, fetch(, http(s).get/.request(, new WebSocket/new WebSocketServer/WebSocketServer(, or spawn/spawnSync/exec* of gh|curl|wget|nc|ssh|scp) under hooks/ scripts/ sdk/ bin/ that is NOT matched by a glob below fails the gate. Bare https?:// string literals (reference/comment URLs, frozen destination constants, spec links) are NOT gated — a bare URL cannot exfiltrate without an accompanying call; those are documented in reference/hone-runtime-audit.md and covered by gitleaks + the threat model. Directory globs (dir/**) are preferred so a new helper added to an already-trusted module does not silently trip the gate, while every glob is asserted to resolve to >=1 real file (test/suite/phase-33-5-audit.test.cjs) so the gate cannot be defeated by an entry that matches nothing. Paths are forward-slash and matched relative to the repo root.

entries.justification: Figma REST extractor — pull.cjs/styles-resolver.cjs fetch the read-only Figma API (https://api.figma.com/v1) with a token read from FIGMA_TOKEN/FIGMA_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env (never persisted/logged), and receiver.cjs runs an EPHEMERAL local node:http handshake server (127.0.0.1, bound for one extract run then exits). Legitimate, read-only, user-initiated.

Issue reporter — outbound is via the `gh` CLI spawn ONLY (gh-submit.cjs/dedup.cjs/gh-absent-fallback.cjs use spawn/spawnSync('gh')); it rides gh's own logged-in auth, the destination repo is frozen (destination.cjs), and an env + .design/config.json kill-switch gates it. No raw HTTP; no GDD-held secret is forwarded.

Peer-CLI broker — spawns LOCAL peer binaries (ACP/ASP clients) over stdio (child_process.spawn, no shell); this is IPC, not network egress. The child env is sanitized to allowlist-forward (default-deny) by 33.5-04 so GDD's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/GH_TOKEN/GDD_* are not leaked to peers.

Event-stream WebSocket transport — runs a WebSocketServer over a node:http upgrade. Hardened in 33.5-03: localhost (127.0.0.1) default bind + opt-in remote, Bearer-token auth (>=8 chars) upgraded to a timing-safe compare. Server-side only; no outbound client connection.

Headless E2E runner (run-headless.ts) — a key-gated live Anthropic API run used only as test infrastructure; gated on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY presence + main-branch and never part of the default `npm test` suite (D-10).

Authority-feed watcher — the design-authority feed module; the live article fetch is delegated to the agents/design-authority-watcher.md runner, and index.cjs is the pure-CommonJS classifier that consumes already-fetched records. Allowlisted so any direct outbound fetch of the authority list added here stays pre-approved rather than tripping the gate.

OpenRouter catalog fetcher — catalog-fetcher.cjs makes a READ-ONLY GET to the OpenRouter models API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) via global fetch, with a Bearer token read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY env (never persisted/logged), atomic-writing the result to the gitignored .design/cache/openrouter-models.json. Graceful-degrade: absent key or fetch failure returns cached-if-any-else-null, never throws. The plugin's first plugin-side outbound REST client; injectable fetchImpl keeps the default suite hermetic (D-07), and there is no new HTTP dependency — global fetch + sdk/primitives only (D-10).

Notification backplane (Phase 35.2) — dispatch.cjs POSTs a routed, REDACTED (scripts/lib/redact.cjs — the single chokepoint) pipeline-event body to Slack/Discord INCOMING WEBHOOKS (SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL/DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env) via an injectable fetchImpl (default global fetch; no @slack/discord SDK). Per-channel kill-switch (GDD_DISABLE_SLACK/DISCORD) + degrade-to-noop (missing URL/disabled/error never throws). Injectable fetchImpl keeps the default suite hermetic (no live webhook); the notify-privacy-guard test asserts no notify module bypasses redact.

Dashboard web launcher (Phase 55) — `gdd dashboard --web` runs an EPHEMERAL LOCAL node:http server (createServer, bound to 127.0.0.1 on an OS-assigned port via listen(0,'127.0.0.1')) that serves a single self-contained, read-only DesignContext graph HTML to the user's own browser, then exits on SIGINT (or skips serving entirely under --once). This is an INBOUND loopback server, not outbound egress: no fetch/.get/.request, no remote bind, no client connection, no secret forwarded. Read-only by design (no state mutation). The browser-open is a child_process spawn of the platform opener (open/start/xdg-open), not a networking CLI.

SessionStart update-check hook — polls the GitHub Releases API (https://api.github.com/repos/hegemonart/hone/releases/latest) via node:https with a 3s timeout, anonymous (no API token), to detect newer plugin versions. Result is cached for 24h at .design/update-cache.json. Silent-on-failure (exits 0 on every error path per D-04). Read-only, user-passive, advisory-only — the hook NEVER writes outside .design/ and NEVER spawns the upgrader itself. Ported from the original update-check.sh (which used curl) to fix Windows-without-Git-Bash hooks; the egress profile is identical to the bash version.
